title.en: Pinjin Pump Prices Are Confirmed by Inquiry, Not a Printed List
title.zh: 品锦泵的价格只通过询盘确认，目录不印价目

description.en: Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai does not print a numeric pump price. Ask on the contact page after the model path and site facts are named.
description.zh: 河北品锦机械在邢台不印泵的数字价格。写明型号路径和现场事实后，在询盘页询问。

h1.en: Ask Xingtai for the Price After the Model Is Named
h1.zh: 写明型号后再向邢台问价格

directAnswer.en: Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai does not publish a list price for electric pumps, diesel pumps or mixer pumps. A quote is confirmed on the contact page after you name the product path and the site facts. This page will not invent a number, a discount or a currency. Spraying machines are marked quote-only in the same way.
directAnswer.zh: 河北品锦机械（邢台）不为电动泵、柴油泵或搅拌泵公布标价。写明产品路径和现场事实后，在询盘页确认报价。本篇不编造数字、折扣或币种。喷涂机同样标明询价报价。

heading.en: What the catalogue shows instead of a price

body.en: Each model page shows power, output, pressure, distance and, where printed, hopper, pipe, weight and dimensions. Those cells are the buying comparison. [/en/products/electric-20-concrete-pump/](/en/products/electric-20-concrete-pump/) is a complete small example: 22 kW, 8–10 m³/h, 10 MPa, 900 kg. None of those cells is a price.
body.zh: 每台型号页给出动力、输送量、压力、距离，以及印了才有的料斗、管径、重量和外形。这些格子才是采购对照。[/zh/products/electric-20-concrete-pump/](/zh/products/electric-20-concrete-pump/) 是一台小型机的完整例子：22 kW、8–10 m³/h、10 MPa、900 kg。这些都不是价格。

heading.en: What to attach so a quote can be answered
heading.zh: 怎样附材料才好回复报价

body.en: Send mix or material, maximum aggregate, required output, horizontal and vertical distance, diesel or voltage and frequency, country and purchase timing, plus the slug. Write to [/en/contact/](/en/contact/), WhatsApp on the site, PinjinHebei@Outlook.com or 19912003025.
body.zh: 请发送材料或配合比、最大骨料、目标输送量、水平与垂直距离、柴油或电压频率、国家与采购时间，并附上型号地址。写到 [/zh/contact/](/zh/contact/)、站内 WhatsApp、PinjinHebei@Outlook.com 或 19912003025。

heading.en: What not to expect in the reply brief
heading.zh: 不要指望回复里有什么

body.en: Do not expect a public price table, a fixed production-day count, or a certificate that the sheet does not name. Custom work, if any, starts only after a listed model is confirmed. Hebei Pinjin Machinery still does not print how many days that takes.
body.zh: 不要期待公开价目、固定生产天数，或参数页没有点名的证书。如需定制，也要先对照已列机型确认。河北品锦机械仍然不印这需要多少天。

question.en: Can you give a sample price number?
question.zh: 能给一个价格样例数字吗？

answer.en: No. This site does not print prices. Ask Xingtai on the contact page.
answer.zh: 不能。本站不印价格。请在询盘页问邢台。

question.en: Are wear parts priced on the pump page?
question.zh: 易损件价格印在泵页上吗？

answer.en: No. Parts pages are also quote-only. Send name, size and quantity if you need them.
answer.zh: 没有。配件页同样只询价。需要时请写名称、尺寸和数量。

question.en: Does a heavier pump imply a printed price band?
question.zh: 更重的泵是否对应已印价格带？

answer.en: Weight is a catalogue cell, for example Diesel 120 at 8000 kg. It is not a price.
answer.zh: 重量是目录格子，例如柴油120为 8000 kg。它不是价格。

answer.en: Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai, after the inquiry names the model.
answer.zh: 河北品锦机械（邢台），在询盘写明型号之后。
